# Artefact formats

## 1. `profile/stack-detected.md` (generated by `extract-stack`; `--json` form validates against `schemas/stack-detected.json`)
One markdown table, one row per repo in `profile/project.md`'s repo table:
`| repo | build | build cmd | test cmd | java | spring-boot | batch | datastore | messaging | web | ui | package root | layout | archunit | pitest | build-file sha256 |`
Values are detected or `unknown`. `layout` = `adapters=<pkg>;application=<pkg>;domain=<pkg>` from stereotype clustering. `archunit` / `pitest` = `installed | missing`. A trailing line `generated: <ISO date> by baton extract-stack <version>`.

## 2. `profile/dependencies.yaml` (generated by `extract`; schema `dependencies.json`)
```yaml
generated: 2026-11-01T10:00:00Z
repos:
  - repo: order-service
    commit: 3f9c2e1
    edges:
      - kind: READS_COLLECTION
        from: class:com.x.orders.OrderRepository
        to: collection:orders
        provenance: {file: src/main/java/com/x/orders/OrderRepository.java, line: 14, extractor: spring-data-generic}
      - kind: EXPOSES
        from: class:com.x.api.CustomerController
        to: "endpoint:GET /api/v1/customers/{id}/orders"
        provenance: {file: ..., line: 31, extractor: request-mapping}
      - kind: CONSUMES
        from: class:com.x.inbound.PaymentListener
        to: topic:payment.events
        provenance: {file: ..., line: 22, extractor: kafka-listener}
```
Kinds: READS_COLLECTION, WRITES_COLLECTION, EXPOSES, CALLS_ENDPOINT, PUBLISHES, CONSUMES, READS_FILE, WRITES_FILE, RUNS_JOB. Extractors (names are part of the contract): `document-annotation`, `spring-data-generic`, `mongo-template-literal`, `request-mapping`, `rest-client-base-url`, `kafka-listener`, `kafka-template`, `jms-listener`, `jms-template`, `flatfile-reader`, `flatfile-writer`, `job-builder`. Unresolvable targets stay literal (`endpoint:${payments.base-url}/...`) and are listed under `unresolved:` for the interview.

## 3. `profile/aggregates.yaml` (seeded by `extract`, confirmed by the Tech Lead; schema `aggregates.json`)
```yaml
aggregates:
  - name: Order
    root: class:com.x.orders.OrderDoc
    collection: orders
    members: [class:com.x.orders.OrderLineDoc]
    references: [Customer]         # other aggregates referenced by id
    confirmed: false
```

## 4. `profile/risk-zones.yaml` (seeded by `extract`, confirmed by the Tech Lead; schema `risk-zones.json`)
```yaml
zones:
  - name: outbound-core-file
    paths: ["**/outbound/**", "**/*ExportFileWriter*"]
    reason: writes a file consumed by the system of record
    cap: 50
  - name: money
    paths: ["**/payments/**", "**/*Decimal128*"]
    reason: money fields
    cap: 50
  - name: auth
    paths: ["**/security/**", "**/*Entitlement*"]
    cap: 50
```
`paths` are gitignore-style globs matched against diff file paths; the lowest cap wins.

## 5. Data profile (W3) - `docs/data-profile/<collection>.json` (schema `data-profile.json`) + `.md` rendering
```json
{ "collection": "invoices", "sampledAt": "...", "sampleSize": 5000, "docCount": 517321,
  "fields": { "issue.dueDate": { "presence": 0.94, "types": {"date": 0.93, "string": 0.01}, "cardinality": 1180 } },
  "sizeBytes": { "p50": 2100, "p95": 9800, "max": 41000 },
  "indexes": [ { "name": "customer_period", "keys": {"customerId": 1, "billingPeriod": 1}, "usedOps": 182334 } ],
  "samples": [ "...masked..." ], "drift": { "since": "...", "added": [], "removed": ["legacyFlag"] } }
```
`unprofiled: true` when the collection was listed in `dependencies.yaml` but could not be sampled. PII list: `schemas/pii-fields.yaml` (names) + patterns (account 8-17 digits, SSN, email, phone). Masking deterministic and total; property test: no original value from the sample survives anywhere in the outputs.

## 6. Wiki page (W4) - `docs/wiki/<repo>/<module>.md`
Frontmatter:
```yaml
---
repo: billing-service
module: application.pricing
generatedFrom: 3f9c2e1
claims:                       # every structural claim, machine-checkable against the extractors
  collections: [invoices, prices]
  topics: []
  endpoints: [GET /invoices/{id}/total]
  calls: [application.port.PriceReadPort]
verified: false               # true only when set by `baton verify`
---
```
Body sections: Purpose - Entry points - Reads / Writes (collections, topics, files) - Calls / Called by - Invariants observed in tests - Known pitfalls (from `docs/context/pitfalls-log.md`) - Last verified. `verify` checks every `claims.*` against `dependencies.yaml` for the same commit; a claim the extractors cannot see is a failure, not a pass. `docs/context/codebase-map.md` becomes the generated index of pages (one line per page, from the frontmatter).

## 7. `impact.json` (W5; schema `impact.json`)
```json
{ "sourceRepo": "billing-service", "changedSymbols": ["InvoiceDoc.dueDate"],
  "impacted": [ { "repo": "reminder-service", "via": "collection:invoices", "file": ".../InvoiceReader.java",
                  "lines": "41-58", "team": "reminders", "breaking": true } ],
  "unknownEdges": [ "queue:INVOICE.OUT has no known consumer in graph" ] }
```

## 8. `mutation.json` (W6; schema `mutation.json`)
`{ "repo": "...", "diffRef": "main...HEAD", "changedClasses": ["..."], "score": 0.83, "killed": 41, "survived": 8, "noCoverage": 2, "notRun": false, "reason": null }` - PIT run with `targetClasses` = changed classes only; `notRun: true` with a reason when PIT is not installed (stack-detected `pitest: missing`) or the build fails.

## 9. `docs/qa/<F>/<S>-diff-shape.md` (base, produced by /build) - unchanged; W1 adds a `--json` twin `-diff-shape.json` for `confidence`.

## 10. Change spec - `docs/design/<F>/<S>-change.yaml` (written by the architect; read by `baton diagram`)
YAML subset (`miniyaml.py`). Keys: `story` (required, must equal the story id), `title`, `repo` (default for ambiguous names), `entries` (entry points to draw: `Class#method` or a resource id), `changed` (`Class#method`, `Class.field`, `Class`, or a resource id; or a map `method:` with `calls:` / use keys), `new` (maps of exactly one of `class:` FQCN with `repo`, `stereotype`, `implements`, `extends`, `uses`, `fields`; `method:` `Class#name` with `signature`, `calledFrom`, `before`, `calls`, and use keys `reads writes publishes consumes exposes callsEndpoint readsFile writesFile` taking resource ids; `field:` `Class.name` with `type`), `removed` (as `changed`; carried into the blast radius as breaking), `useCases` (`name`, `actor`, `entry`, `includes`). Any other key is an error. Existing names must resolve in the code map; new names must not.

## 11. Diagram set (`baton diagram story` / `architecture`)
A folder of `*.svg` (standalone, white background, `data-generator="baton-diagram"`), `diagrams.md` (generated header, tables, each diagram as `![..](x.svg)` plus its Mermaid source in a `<details>` block), `index.html` (self-contained, no network), `diagrams.json`. Story sets: `flow.svg`, `sequence-<n>.svg` (one per entry point, at most 5), `lld.svg`, `data-model.svg` (when a collection is on the paths), `use-cases.svg`; `diagrams.json` = `{story, title, source, entries[{entry, title}], touchPoints[{status, repo, element, file, lines, reachedFrom[], tests[]}], impacted[impact.json rows + from], unknownEdges[], conformance{undeclared, notBuilt, newClassesUndeclared, newClassesNotBuilt} | null, notes[], files[]}`. Statuses: `new | changed | removed | impacted | touched`. Byte-identical for the same spec and code. Never hand-edited.
